reason: Normalizes Claude Code harness usage the way #602 normalized the Anthropic/Bedrock provider adapters: _claude_detailed_usage now sums input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens into input_tokens (reads kept in cached_input_tokens/cache_read_input_tokens, writes in cache_creation_input_tokens), and HarnessDetailedUsage.basic() carries the cached/creation counts into ChatTokenUsage. basic() is only called by the Claude connection. Selected: the new recorded-payload tests (unit parity with _anthropic_usage, real ClaudeSDKClient chat turn persisting ChatTurn/ChatMessage/HarnessTurn usage and live usage events, mission run spend, legacy rows); the Claude harness turn, turn-cost and queued-guidance (_claude_combined_usage) suites that run the same connection over scripted CLIs; and the provider prompt-caching tests whose normalization this mirrors. Counts from pytest --collect-only.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no UI, Rust or wire-shape change (the UI renders only total_tokens for harness usage and ignores the ChatTokenUsage cache fields). Codex and Grok adapter tests are excluded: Codex builds its ChatTokenUsage without basic() and Grok reports no token counts, so neither path changed. test_harness_adapters.py/test_harnesses.py use Claude payloads without cache fields, which normalize to the same numbers. No full suite.
